reference_input_mode: none; source data and scientific question
palette: first two colors of packaged notch2-balanced
transformation: For the same donor_id, arm and analyte: log2_abundance at follow-up minus log2_abundance at week 0.
independent_unit: participant (donor_id); visits and analytes are repeated measurements
missingness: Available baseline-follow-up pairs separately at each week. No imputation or complete-case requirement across both follow-ups.

summary.interval: 25th to 75th percentile, linear interpolation; describes participant variability, not confidence

chart: two aligned week facets; six protein rows; two arm subrows; participant dots, median and IQR
mark_outline_policy: All filled data points, median diamonds, boxes and categorical legend keys are borderless. Whiskers, median lines and IQR lines are separate line encodings.
in_artwork_text: Protein IDs, week facet labels, x-axis label, ticks and arm legend only; no overall title, subtitle, footnote or panel letter.
comparison_baseline: Tukey box-and-points at same dimensions, mapping, font and scale
